variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic image: keep the pack in the attached photo exactly as it is, with every colour, line of text and graphic on it identical, and keep its size, angle and soft contact shadow. Place it on a seamless pure white surface (#FFFFFF) lit by soft daylight from the upper left (about 5600K), square 1:1, with the pack on the right half of the frame. Add only a small swatch of this product's texture, a smooth, thick, off-white cream smear (a heavy cream), resting on the white surface to the left of the pack, about the size of a coin, with a soft natural highlight and a gentle contact shadow. The rest of the frame is intentionally empty. Do not include: any text or letters other than what is already on the pack, any logos, any second pack or bottle, any props, hands or people.
variants.negative_prompt: added text, extra logos, second pack, altered label, altered pack colours, props, hands, people, busy background
